name: grammar-workbench-lsp
description: Grammar language server for .grammarworkbench grammars and their source documents

grammarWorkbench.serverPath.description: Path to the grammar-workbench-lsp server binary (built with: swift build --product grammar-workbench-lsp).

grammarWorkbench.associations.description: Maps file globs to grammar names, e.g. {"*.prog": "prog"}. A matching source document is opened with the grammar base name as its language id, so prog.grammarworkbench analyzes *.prog files.
